A few fair questions.

Do we need a mature ESG programme to work together?+

No. We can begin with one customer request, a small evidence review or your first action plan. If your programme is already established, we can define a focused project that supports your team.

Can you guarantee a rating, certification or new business?+

No. I help you improve the work and the evidence behind it. Rating and certification decisions belong to the relevant bodies. Commercial results depend on your buyers and market, as well as your wider offer.

What does a first engagement look like?+

We start by discussing your business need, existing material and deadlines. You receive a proposed scope, deliverables, schedule and quote. The first project should be small enough to complete and useful enough to build on.

Is this only about environmental reporting?+

No. CSR also concerns people, working practices, purchasing and governance. The starting point is what matters to your business and stakeholders. For specialist assurance or legal advice, we identify the right qualified support.
